5709304834.body:
**Auth independent review — supplier patch `befe794` consume_link atomicity (Bugbot 4033370835). Fresh-context reviewer under cos `cse_017tAuUoGnwUgSZGGu8x6rAP`. Findings unedited. Not merge authority.**

**Target:** klappy/3d-review-app `integration/first-increment-20260917` @ `befe794497515684656b93e21570d9749349ab5b` (child of `dafefe12`), Cursor Autofix "fix: atomic email-code redeem and distinct conflict-recovery kinds". Scope: Auth part only — `src/handlers/platform.ts` `authConsumeLink` and its test in `test/synthetic-owner-auth.test.ts`. UI part (`ui/app.js`, `ui/shared-link.js`, `test/shared-link-browser.test.ts`) is Design's: it touches no Auth path (no `src/auth.ts`, `src/oauth.ts`, `src/index.ts`, `src/dispatch.ts`, no handler) — noted, not reviewed.

### Verdict (Auth part): **ACCEPT-WITH-NIT**

The 2-line hunk is correct and sufficient for the reported defect. The guarded `UPDATE … WHERE id = ? AND redeemed_at IS NULL` with `meta.changes !== 1 → code_used` makes the single-writer SQLite UPDATE the sole redemption authority; only one caller can observe `changes === 1`. Reproduced the defect on base and its closure on head with real Miniflare D1.

### Verified (real Miniflare D1, migrations 0001–0004 + 0006 + 0007, `ENVIRONMENT=dev`, permissive fake limiters, HTTP face via `app.fetch`)

| # | Probe | dafefe12 (base) | befe794 (head) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 8 concurrent `POST /v2/auth/session`, one `dev_only_code` | **8×200, 8 session rows, 0 code_used** (defect confirmed) | **1×200, 7×400 `INVALID_PARAMS/code_used`, 1 session row** |
| 2 | Supplier's test `overlapping consume of one email code mints only one session` | **fails** (`expected … length of 1 but got 2`) → test is falsifying | passes |
| 3a | Sequential reuse of a redeemed code | n/a | 400 `code_used`, still 1 session |
| 3b | Expired code (`expires_at` set to now-1s) | n/a | 400 `code_expired`, 0 sessions, `redeemed_at` stays NULL |
| 4 | Wrong code | n/a | 400 `code invalid`, 0 sessions |
| 5 | Winner's token on `GET /v2/me` | n/a | 200, `principal.id === principal_id` |
| 6 | `git diff --stat dafefe12..befe794` | 5 files: `src/handlers/platform.ts` (+2/−1), `test/synthetic-owner-auth.test.ts` (+24), `ui/app.js`, `ui/shared-link.js`, `test/shared-link-browser.test.ts`. **No** schema/migration/wrangler/contract/package/lockfile change; `package-lock.json` byte-identical to wt-pr15. `src/auth.ts`, `src/oauth.ts`, `src/index.ts`, `src/dispatch.ts`, `src/registry.ts` unchanged. | |
| 7 | `tsc --noEmit` → 0 errors; `vitest run` → **25 files / 127 tests passed**, 0 failed | | |

Probe file was written untracked in a detached worktree, run against head sources and (by swapping only `platform.ts` to the dafefe12 blob) base sources, then removed. Nothing pushed, modified or merged.

### Expiry window reasoning (asked)

At head the only expiry check is the JS pre-check `row.expires_at < Date.now()`; the UPDATE has no expiry clause. The exposure is: a code that is unexpired at the SELECT/pre-check instant but crosses `expires_at` before the UPDATE executes gets redeemed. That gap is one awaited D1 round-trip (sub-ms to low ms), the code was inside its 10-minute validity at the check, and the guard still admits exactly one redemption — no second session, no reuse of a stale code beyond the round-trip latency. There is no path where an already-expired-at-check code passes. **I rate Worker D's `AND expires_at >= ?` clause a nit (defence-in-depth: SQL becomes sole authority for both invariants), not a required amendment.**

### Comparison vs Worker D `fix/consume-link-atomic` @ `46b96200`

- **Supplier (befe794):** 2-line handler hunk + 24-line test appended to an existing file. Smaller. Correct for the race.
- **Worker D (46b96200):** guard adds `expires_at >= ?`, re-reads on 0 changes to distinguish `code_used`/`code_expired`/`code invalid`, plus a dedicated `test/consume-link-atomic.test.ts` (5 cases, HTTP face, own migrations, 5-way race). Larger. Also correct.
- **What D adds that is required:** nothing. What D adds that is better: (i) expiry inside the guard (nit above); (ii) the test exercises the real HTTP route with fresh migrations rather than `execute()` via dispatch, and asserts the `code_used` message and the 400 status.

### Nits on the supplier's test (non-blocking)

1. Race width is 2 (`Promise.all([a, b])`); my 8-way probe passed, but the committed test is the weakest falsifier that still fails on base.
2. Depends on the preceding `it` in the same file having applied `0001_init.sql` + seed (shared `mf`, no `beforeAll`); running it in isolation (`-t "overlapping"`) would hit a missing table. Order-coupled, not wrong.
3. Asserts only `error.code === "INVALID_PARAMS"`, not `message === "code_used"`; drives `cap.auth.consume_link` through `execute()` not `POST /v2/auth/session`, so the HTTP 400 mapping is not covered by this test (it is covered by my probe).
4. The now-redundant JS `if (row.used_at)` pre-check remains; harmless (fast-path error), fine to keep.

### Could not verify

- Production D1 behaviour (only Miniflare/SQLite local); the atomicity argument rests on SQLite single-writer semantics, which D1 shares.
- Whether the base-suite count at dafefe12 was 126 (i.e. +1 from this test) — not run; head is 127/127.

**Bounded re-run receipt — Auditor seat. Head `884c4c1bdae1db9c6ff2b221936438fb01236bb9` (dafefe1 → befe794 supplier patch → 884c4c1 R-15 fix). Run START 05:31:57Z → END 05:37:26Z (observed). Fresh-context runner, findings unedited; my read at the end. This head was not declared frozen at run time — coverage below is attributed to `884c4c1` exactly; the `dafefe1` definitive proof (5709198299) stands as prior evidence for everything not re-run here.**

### Diff dafefe1..884c4c1 (ui/ src/) — OBSERVED
- `ui/app.js:375-380` (R-15): receipt probe wrapped — `if (token === null && entryFailureKind(error, true) === 'cannotResume') { showSharedUnavailable('cannotResume'); return; } throw error;`
- `ui/app.js:326` (befe794): after `resolveConflict`, rateLimited/transient → their copy; else `showSharedUnavailable(resolved.state)`.
- `ui/shared-link.js:135-138` `resolveConflict` catch → `unavailable` / `rateLimited` / `transient`.
- `src/handlers/platform.ts:48-49`: CAS `UPDATE login_code … AND redeemed_at IS NULL`, `changes !== 1` → `code_used`.

### Part A — OBSERVED
tsc clean · full vitest **25 files, 129/129** · Table B harness **22 / 0 / 2 skipped**.

### Part B — real Chromium, wrangler dev :8790, local D1 (0001–0004, 0006, 0007 + seed)
| Case | Requests | Copy | Storage / UI | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **R-15** own session revoked, link valid, reload w/o fragment, stale bearer | exactly one `GET /receipt` → 401; **no POST /link** | cannotResume ("…that send may have succeeded without a confirmation shown here; the facilitator can confirm…") | sessionStorage byte-identical; no buttons/recover/review/form; **`#error` hidden, text "" — no NOT_AUTHENTICATED** | **PASS — defect closed** |
| **R-9** same state, real reopen with fragment | one POST /link (+resume) → 404, no retry | cannotResume | identical; `#error` "" | PASS (fresh device still gets 17 questions) |
| **R-10** submitted, session expired, reopen | one POST → 404 | cannotResume | identical; counts unchanged 2/2; session rows unchanged | PASS |
| **R-P4** healthy reload after submit | `GET /receipt` 200 only | own receipt | — | PASS |

Conflict-error regressions (intercept on `POST /v2/participate/responses`, real submit click):
| Case | Requests | `#participant-resume` | `#error` (raw) | key / draft | Retry after release |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| (a) 429 RATE_LIMITED | 1 POST → 429; no /link, no /receipt | rateLimited copy | "RATE_LIMITED: too many attempts — slow down" | PRESERVED / PRESERVED; Submit re-enabled | 1 POST **same key**, 200 `duplicate:false`, receipt; key+draft cleared |
| (b1) 503 | 1 POST → 503 | submitFailed ("Your answers were not submitted. They are still here; try again.") | "INTERNAL: upstream unavailable" | PRESERVED | 1 POST same key, 200, receipt |
| (b2) network abort | 1 POST → ERR_CONNECTION_FAILED | submitFailed | "Local API unavailable…outcome is unknown…" | PRESERVED | 1 POST same key, 200, receipt |
| (c) 409 "response already submitted" (simulated; receipt still `submitted:false`) | 1 POST → 409, then 1 `GET /receipt` | collectionClosed copy (artefact of the simulation: `resolveConflict` maps `submitted:false` → closed, `shared-link.js:140`; a real 409 has `submitted:true` → own receipt, proven at dafefe1 P6) | "STAGE_CONFLICT: response already submitted" | PRESERVED; review/form hidden; only "Recover receipt" — no UI retry path | not exercised |
| (d) 400 "idempotency key has different answers" | 1 POST → 400 | submitFailed | "INVALID_PARAMS: …" | PRESERVED | 1 POST same key, 200, receipt |

R-16 across all: exactly one POST /responses per click; zero POST /link; participant_session and survey counts unchanged during each failure. Page errors: 0.

### Observations — INFERRED (pre-existing, not introduced by 884c4c1)
1. **Raw server code reaches `#error` on every submit failure** (`ui/app.js:328 throw` → `fail(error.message)` at `:16`; message `${code}: ${message}` from `shared-link.js:166`). R-15's "no raw code" guarantee holds on the entry path only.
2. 503 and 400 on the POST itself fall to `submitFailed`; the new transient/rateLimited copy fires only when the *receipt probe inside resolveConflict* fails (`ui/app.js:327-328`). Behavioural outcome (key/draft preserved, same-key retry) is correct.
3. Simulated 409 + `submitted:false` leaves the participant with only "Recover receipt"; real-world reachability doubtful (server 409s only after a committed response).

### Not exercised
resolveConflict's rateLimited/transient branches (need 409 on POST + 429/5xx on the follow-up GET); `platform.ts` CAS in browser (vitest 129/129 covers; Auth's review 5709304834 covers the race).

---

**Auditor's read:** R-15 is closed at `884c4c1` — the dead-own-session reload now tells the truth and leaks nothing, with storage, counts and no-new-action intact. Both Autofix pieces behave as Auth's review says on the API side, and on the UI side every conflict/failure path preserves the idempotency key and draft and retries **once with the same key** — no duplicate rows, no new respondents. Coverage statement, qualified: everything in the R-15 subset and the conflict matrix is proven at `884c4c1`; R-P1–P3, P5–P9, R-1–R-8, R-11–R-13 and the SIM states were proven at `dafefe1` and the diff between the two touches only the lines quoted above (`ui/app.js:326,375-380`, `shared-link.js:135-138`, `platform.ts:48-49`, tests) — I have not re-run them and do not claim an unqualified pass on `884c4c1`. Observation 1 (raw code in `#error` on submit failure) is the same double-render family flagged earlier; a one-line cosmetic candidate for the next increment, not this one. If root freezes `884c4c1`, this receipt is the browser proof for it; if a later SHA is frozen, the same ~8-minute subset re-runs. No merge disposition from this seat.

Each case: fresh participant context → open link → fill → review → click "Submit once" with route interception. Real Chromium, `wrangler dev --local` :8790 (already up), local D1 0001–0004 + 0006 + 0007 + seed.

| | M1: 409 → GET receipt **429** | M2: 409 → GET receipt **503** | M3: 409 → GET receipt **network abort** |
|---|---|---|---|
| Requests | POST /responses (409 STAGE_CONFLICT) · GET /receipt (429) · **0 POST /link** · nothing else | POST (409) · GET /receipt (503) · 0 /link | POST (409) · GET /receipt ERR_CONNECTION_FAILED · 0 /link |
| `#participant-resume` exact | "Too many requests right now. Nothing saved on this device was changed; wait a moment and open your link again." (rateLimited) | "The server could not be reached or did not answer. Nothing saved on this device was changed; open your link again in a moment." (transient) | identical to M2 (transient) |
| `#error` raw (pre-existing residual, recorded not judged) | "STAGE_CONFLICT: response already submitted" | same | same |
| sessionStorage | bearer, draft, `shared:current` byte-identical; only difference = `submitKey` **added** (minted lazily on first submit, `shared-link.js:186-187`); a second intercepted attempt is byte-identical to the first-after state | same | same |
| Buttons | Edit · Submit once · Recover receipt; review shown, submit enabled | same | same |
| counts / participant_session rows | unchanged during the intercepted attempt | unchanged | unchanged |
| Released retry via UI | 1 POST, **same** idempotency_key → 200 `duplicate:false`, receipt; key+draft cleared | same | same |

Copy distinctness: M1 ≠ M2/M3; M2 = M3 (by design: both `transient`); none equal cannotResume / collectionClosed / linkUnavailable. Page errors: 0.

**Verdict vs the accepted minimum:** distinct copy per branch **PASS**; bearer/draft/key preserved, no clearing, no new open **PASS** (0 POST /link); no new respondent during failure **PASS** — counts advanced only through the three legitimately released retries (server never persisted under intercepts, so `duplicate:false` is the expected outcome). Harness note: my first run flagged two FAILs that were artefacts (pre-snapshot taken before the lazy key mint; `requestfailed` double-count); corrected and re-run, logged in `proof-m.log`.

**Residuals preserved as full-goal items, not repaired here:** raw `CODE: message` still paints into `#error` beside the friendly copy on submit/conflict failures (`ui/app.js:16/328`); direct 503/400 on the POST use `submitFailed` wording rather than the transient copy (5709413538 obs. 2).

Artifacts: `wtr15-proof/proof-m.mjs`, `proof-m.log`, `net-m.json`, `M1/M2/M3(-pre/-retry).png`. No merge disposition from this seat.
